inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL aggregation groups records by location and year, concatenates distinct members in deterministic order, counts distinct members, and keeps only groups with more than one member through HAVING.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a venue-season match summary. Played matches are grouped by venue and season, distinct home clubs are concatenated with an explicit separator and ordering, and single-club seasons are removed by a distinct-count HAVING threshold.

fixture_notes: Venue 31 has repeated AFC matches plus BFC in 2023 and only AFC in 2024; venue 32 has BFC and CFC played matches plus one cancelled DFC match. HAVING keeps only seasons with multiple played home clubs.
determinism_notes: Venue IDs, seasons, statuses, club codes, GROUP_CONCAT ordering, separator, grouping, and final ORDER BY are fixed; the fixture has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE venue_matches (match_id INT PRIMARY KEY, venue_id INT NOT NULL, season_year INT NOT NULL, home_club_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, match_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT venue_id, season_year, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT home_club_code ORDER BY home_club_code SEPARATOR '|') AS home_clubs, COUNT(*) AS played_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT home_club_code) AS club_count FROM venue_matches WHERE match_status = 'played' GROUP BY venue_id, season_year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT home_club_code) > 1 ORDER BY season_year, venue_id

checks.sql: SELECT match_id, venue_id, season_year, home_club_code, match_status FROM venue_matches ORDER BY match_id
